from datetime import date

from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Border, Font, PatternFill, Side
from openpyxl.worksheet.page import PageMargins


OUTPUT_FILE = "Acme_Invoice_INV-2024-001.xlsx"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Invoice"
ws.sheet_view.showGridLines = False

# Colors and reusable styles
navy = "1F4E78"
blue = "5B9BD5"
light_blue = "D9EAF7"
white = "FFFFFF"
gray = "666666"

thin_gray = Side(style="thin", color="B7B7B7")
border = Border(
    left=thin_gray,
    right=thin_gray,
    top=thin_gray,
    bottom=thin_gray,
)

currency_format = '$#,##0.00'
date_format = "mmmm d, yyyy"

# Page and column setup
column_widths = {
    "A": 23,
    "B": 28,
    "C": 12,
    "D": 16,
    "E": 16,
}

for column, width in column_widths.items():
    ws.column_dimensions[column].width = width

ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 34
ws.freeze_panes = "A14"
ws.print_area = "A1:E23"
ws.page_setup.orientation = "portrait"
ws.page_setup.paperSize = ws.PAPERSIZE_LETTER
ws.page_setup.fitToWidth = 1
ws.page_setup.fitToHeight = 1
ws.sheet_properties.pageSetUpPr.fitToPage = True
ws.page_margins = PageMargins(
    left=0.35,
    right=0.35,
    top=0.5,
    bottom=0.5,
    header=0.2,
    footer=0.2,
)

# Invoice title
ws.merge_cells("A1:E1")
ws["A1"] = "INVOICE"
ws["A1"].font = Font(size=22, bold=True, color=white)
ws["A1"].fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=navy)
ws["A1"].alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")

# Vendor details
ws["A3"] = "FROM"
ws["A3"].font = Font(bold=True, color=white)
ws["A3"].fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=blue)

ws["A4"] = "Acme Supplies Inc."
ws["A4"].font = Font(size=13, bold=True, color=navy)
ws.merge_cells("A4:C4")

ws["A5"] = "123 Main Street"
ws["A6"] = "Springfield, IL 62701"
ws["A7"] = "(555) 123-4567"
ws["A8"] = "billing@acmesupplies.com"

for cell in ("A5", "A6", "A7", "A8"):
    ws.merge_cells(start_row=ws[cell].row, start_column=1,
                   end_row=ws[cell].row, end_column=3)

# Invoice metadata
metadata = [
    ("D3", "Invoice Number", "E3", "INV-2024-001"),
    ("D4", "Invoice Date", "E4", date(2024, 6, 1)),
    ("D5", "Due Date", "E5", date(2024, 6, 15)),
]

for label_cell, label, value_cell, value in metadata:
    ws[label_cell] = label
    ws[label_cell].font = Font(bold=True, color=navy)
    ws[label_cell].fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=light_blue)
    ws[label_cell].border = border

    ws[value_cell] = value
    ws[value_cell].border = border
    ws[value_cell].alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right")

ws["E4"].number_format = date_format
ws["E5"].number_format = date_format

# Customer information
ws.merge_cells("A10:E10")
ws["A10"] = "BILL TO"
ws["A10"].font = Font(bold=True, color=white)
ws["A10"].fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=blue)
ws["A10"].alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left")

ws["A11"] = "Alice Smith"
ws["A11"].font = Font(bold=True, color=navy)
ws.merge_cells("A11:E11")

ws["A12"] = "Alice Consulting — 456 Oak Avenue, Springfield, IL 62702"
ws.merge_cells("A12:E12")

# Line-item headers
headers = ["Description", "Details", "Quantity", "Unit Price", "Amount"]

for column_number, header in enumerate(headers, start=1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=14, column=column_number, value=header)
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color=white)
    cell.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=navy)
    cell.border = border
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")

# Items: the amount column uses formulas
items = [
    ("Office Paper", "500 sheets", 10, 5.00),
    ("Ink Cartridge", "", 2, 30.00),
]

for row_number, (description, details, quantity, unit_price) in enumerate(
    items, start=15
):
    ws.cell(row=row_number, column=1, value=description)
    ws.cell(row=row_number, column=2, value=details)
    ws.cell(row=row_number, column=3, value=quantity)
    ws.cell(row=row_number, column=4, value=unit_price)
    ws.cell(
        row=row_number,
        column=5,
        value=f"=C{row_number}*D{row_number}",
    )

    for column_number in range(1, 6):
        cell = ws.cell(row=row_number, column=column_number)

        )

    ws.cell(row=row_number, column=4).number_format = currency_format
    ws.cell(row=row_number, column=5).number_format = currency_format

# Totals and formulas
ws["D18"] = "Subtotal"
ws["E18"] = "=SUM(E15:E16)"

ws["D19"] = "Tax (8%)"
ws["E19"] = "=E18*8%"

ws["D20"] = "TOTAL"
ws["E20"] = "=E18+E19"

for row_number in range(18, 21):
    ws[f"D{row_number}"].font = Font(
        bold=True,
        color=white if row_number == 20 else navy,
    )
    ws[f"E{row_number}"].font = Font(
        bold=True,
        color=white if row_number == 20 else navy,
    )

    fill_color = navy if row_number == 20 else light_blue
    ws[f"D{row_number}"].fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=fill_color)
    ws[f"E{row_number}"].fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=fill_color)

    ws[f"D{row_number}"].border = border
    ws[f"E{row_number}"].border = border
    ws[f"E{row_number}"].number_format = currency_format
    ws[f"E{row_number}"].alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right")

# Payment terms and note
ws["A22"] = "Payment Terms:"
ws["A22"].font = Font(bold=True, color=navy)
ws["B22"] = "Net 14"

ws["A23"] = "Notes:"
ws["A23"].font = Font(bold=True, color=navy)
ws.merge_cells("B23:E23")
ws["B23"] = "Thank you for your business!"
ws["B23"].font = Font(italic=True, color=gray)

# Consistent wrapping and vertical alignment
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=23, min_col=1, max_col=5):
    for cell in row:
        if cell.coordinate not in ("A1",):
            cell.alignment = Alignment(
                horizontal=cell.alignment.horizontal,
                vertical="center",
                wrap_text=True,
            )

# Footer
ws.oddFooter.center.text = "Acme Supplies Inc. | INV-2024-001"
ws.oddFooter.center.size = 8
ws.oddFooter.center.color = gray

wb.save(OUTPUT_FILE)
print(f"Created: {OUTPUT_FILE}")
